scientific_purpose: Investigate native Abaqus *RESTART on identical 2,906-element mesh as a positive control to experimentally determine whether Abaqus preserves UEL SVARS and whether Fortran COMMON /CB_STATE_TRANS/ is wiped or restored across restart boundaries.

hypotheses_and_predictions.hypothesis_1_svars_restoration: Abaqus serializes and restores UEL SVARS into the recipient elements from the .res file.
hypotheses_and_predictions.hypothesis_2_common_block_loss: Abaqus does NOT serialize Fortran COMMON /CB_STATE_TRANS/. In the restart process, static memory starts zeroed, and because UEXTERNALDB does not implement LOP=4 and UEL lines 248-261 check KSTEP.EQ.1 (which is FALSE for restarted Step 2), COMMON state is NOT restored, causing Layer 1/2 state decoupling unless re-equilibrated as in Package 47.
hypotheses_and_predictions.hypothesis_3_diagnostic_uel_restoration: Diagnostic UEL restores SVARS into COMMON /CB_STATE_TRANS/ upon first increment entry via SV_INGESTED flag, enabling authentic continuation without modifying constitutive relations.

acceptance_criteria.criterion_1_donor_datacheck: Donor deck passes Abaqus datacheck Exit 0.
acceptance_criteria.criterion_2_restart_datacheck: Restart recipient deck passes Abaqus restart datacheck Exit 0.
acceptance_criteria.criterion_3_experimental_distinction: Defines an exact experimental test distinguishing native restart from history-initialized static re-equilibration (Package 47).
